hero.statement: I build cinematic, scroll-driven web experiences: 3D, motion and interfaces that feel alive.
hero.availability: Open to full-time roles, in France or remote.

about.intro: I'm Mathis, a front-end developer based in France. I build websites that behave more like films than documents: scroll-driven 3D, motion, and type that reacts to you.

items.title: Scroll as a camera
items.description: In Aetherius the whole site is one camera move through fog. In Nocturne a chrome form follows you from section to section. I like turning scrolling into direction, not just navigation.

items.title: Built, not imported
items.description: I'd rather make it than download it. The figures in Aetherius are generated in code, ring by ring, and the name at the top of this site is thousands of particles sampled from the heading itself.

items.title: Real clients, real constraints
items.description: Atelier Lvy is a ceramic artist's business, not a concept. Shipping it taught me that bookings and readability come before effects.

items.title: Small things, finished
items.description: Some projects are just for fun: a dice game I sent to friends, a Pokémon gacha, a counter for my own job search. Finishing small things is how I learn the most.
